entries.text: Rise, Ankhu.
Your voice has come back to you, Ankhu. Here, words are the only hands you have.

alignment.characters: Your voice has come back to you, Ankhu. Here, words are the only hands you have.

entries.text: Water listens to a direction. Say flow, then west or east.

alignment.characters: Water listens to a direction. Say flow, then west or east.

entries.text: The gallery is above us. Watch what the water carries before you ask it to move.

alignment.characters: The gallery is above us. Watch what the water carries before you ask it to move.

entries.text: The platform rides on the water. Where must the water go for it to come down to you?

alignment.characters: The platform rides on the water. Where must the water go for it to come down to you?

entries.text: The ladder is rolled up above. There is another way to rise.

alignment.characters: The ladder is rolled up above. There is another way to rise.

entries.text: You stand between floors. Let the water choose your height.

alignment.characters: You stand between floors. Let the water choose your height.

entries.text: That word has no power here yet. In this room only the water listens.

alignment.characters: That word has no power here yet. In this room only the water listens.

entries.text: You did not climb. You asked, and the water carried you.

alignment.characters: You did not climb. You asked, and the water carried you.

entries.text: The mirror floats on the western raft. The raft rises only when the water goes west, and then your platform sinks.

alignment.characters: The mirror floats on the western raft. The raft rises only when the water goes west, and then your platform sinks.

entries.text: Some things must stay where they are after their support is gone. Say bind, then the thing you would hold.

alignment.characters: Some things must stay where they are after their support is gone. Say bind, then the thing you would hold.

entries.text: Bring the mirror to the gallery, and leave nothing bound behind you.

alignment.characters: Bring the mirror to the gallery, and leave nothing bound behind you.

entries.text: That thread carries the whole platform now. Give its weight back to the water first.

alignment.characters: That thread carries the whole platform now. Give its weight back to the water first.

entries.text: You can only hold the platform while you stand on it, high in the shaft.

alignment.characters: You can only hold the platform while you stand on it, high in the shaft.

entries.text: The raft rises only with the water in the west. Can your platform stay high without the water?

alignment.characters: The raft rises only with the water in the west. Can your platform stay high without the water?

entries.text: That word has no power here yet. Hold, release, and move the water.

alignment.characters: That word has no power here yet. Hold, release, and move the water.

entries.text: You held only as long as you needed to. Remember the feeling of letting go.

alignment.characters: You held only as long as you needed to. Remember the feeling of letting go.

entries.text: The far seal wants light. The near seal wants shadow. The gate ahead will ask for both at once.

alignment.characters: The far seal wants light. The near seal wants shadow. The gate ahead will ask for both at once.

entries.text: The sleeper stands in the beam and casts the shadow. Wake him and he walks out of the light. His shadow follows him.

alignment.characters: The sleeper stands in the beam and casts the shadow. Wake him and he walks out of the light. His shadow follows him.

entries.text: Unless you hold it first. And you still hold two threads from before. Your voice can carry no more than two.

alignment.characters: Unless you hold it first. And you still hold two threads from before. Your voice can carry no more than two.

entries.text: That thread carries the platform. Give its weight to the water first.

alignment.characters: That thread carries the platform. Give its weight to the water first.

entries.text: Your voice already holds two threads. Which one do you still need?

alignment.characters: Your voice already holds two threads. Which one do you still need?

entries.text: There is no shadow to hold. Perhaps its owner should rest again.

alignment.characters: There is no shadow to hold. Perhaps its owner should rest again.

entries.text: That word has no power here yet. Hold, release, wake, sleep, and move the water.

alignment.characters: That word has no power here yet. Hold, release, wake, sleep, and move the water.

entries.text: The shadow stays though its owner has gone. You will need this again.

alignment.characters: The shadow stays though its owner has gone. You will need this again.
